dispositions.remedy_reviewed: First append calls _require_settled after owner lock and replay/conflict handling but before qualification and either M2/receipt write. Committed stage_started/release_started, staged binding or incomplete/uncertain settlement refuses NEEDS_RECONCILIATION. Intent is not reset. Both append and reserve use managed_store.lock -> managed-owner:<owner>.
ordering_trace: Reservation first: managed_admission.py:421 takes owner lock; :430 revalidates retained stage material; :452 persists operation_started. native_tasks.py:238-256 and :288-310 commit reservation before the later sink. The append guard sees persistent intent and refuses until genuine terminal settlement; it does not try to extend DB locking into network atomicity.

Append first: owner lock spans graph/settlement/qualification and M2+command receipt commit. A later reserve takes the same lock and re-reads the graph through stage_payload (:465-482); require_no_revision refuses before updating intent or reaching native send.

Release on a never-staged assignment has no authentic binding. reserve_dispatch:425-426 refuses BINDING_REQUIRED first; there is no supported route to manufacture a binding after M2. The PG oracle explicitly preserves that actual denial rather than claiming a bound release reached the M2 predicate.
